name: Runx
tagline: Find governed agent skills and inspect their authority before running them
description: Search the Runx skill registry and read a skill's full manifest, publisher, trust signals, requested authority, version, and exact install command. This hosted MCP is a read-only discovery surface; skill execution happens through the open-source Runx runtime.

install.notes: Read-only registry tools. Install and execute a chosen skill with the Runx runtime after reviewing its authority.
